roadmap.estimate_basis: E07 measured 26 seconds and needed a 386-line runner. E09's 200 journeys need 5,200 seconds (87 minutes) at that rate before E10/E13, authoring, capture, and audit. roadmap.evidence_gate: Run verification/harness/run-expectation.sh E08, E09-v2, E10, E11, E12, and E13 in the local Git checkout. Each runner owns cargo xtask metal run and returns remote output for local pinned verification.yaml, different-fox audit, and README/INDEX updates.
notes: ADR-0090/0091 govern. No new public API, runner, VM Exec probe, or lifecycle owner.
Rejected: configuration cannot remove parser rejection; one file cannot cross schema/CLI/runtime; one mega-step defeats bounded review.
Atomic RED: replace each owned panic with assertions and remove its exact should_panic marker together.
EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: proptest/state-delta where amplifiable; seeded/integration/E2E remain examples. Pure properties use exactly /// CONTRACT_SHAPE: pure-function.
Rust stays in-process; E08, E09-v2, and E10-E13 drive checked-in examples through the built binary, never tests or crates.
Scope lists allow related compiler/test/manifest/harness/configuration fallout. Accepted DESIGN/ADRs are read-only.

ADR-0101 revision 4 D7 is the exact contract: revision-3 ServiceLifecycle ownership and direct BackendDiscoveryBridge retirement remain, with only the approved local direct-VIP action-selection exception.
02-03 is amended from the uncompleted verification-only shape to the ADR-0101 prerequisite; its pre-amendment RED events remain historical in execution-log.json and are not inherited execution.

BE-01 through BE-12 and BE-P1 are approved acceptance-designer artifacts. Acceptance-designer ownership covers transfer or retirement of obsolete bridge-specific tests and wrappers; crafters do not invent contracts.
E09-v2 is one build/prepare, one persistent control plane, controlled concurrent Service cycles, and exactly 100 honest pairs with no retries or discarded trials.

final_mutation_gate.after: All nine step reviews and E08, E09-v2, and E10-E13 evidence audits are approved
final_mutation_gate.command: cargo xtask lima run -- bash -lc "cargo xtask mutants --diff origin/main --features integration-tests && jq -e --argjson baseline \"\$(cat mutants-baseline/main/kill_rate.txt)\" '.status == \"pass\" and .kill_rate_pct >= 80 and .kill_rate_pct >= (\$baseline - 2)' target/xtask/mutants-summary.json"
final_mutation_gate.pass: The compound command exits 0, enforcing wrapper pass, kill rate at least 80%, and baseline drift no worse than -2 percentage points; investigate timeout/unviable outcomes.
final_mutation_gate.discipline: Run once, never per step; do not edit mutation exclusions.

steps.name: Atomic ServiceSpecV3 ingress
steps.description: Cut V3 and every direct compiler consumer together, including aggregate and both CLI lanes.
criteria: ServiceSpec/Latest alias exact-field direct V3; the sole direct ServiceSpecEnvelope::V3(ServiceSpecV3) arm has tag [0]; one current direct FIXTURE_V3 written through latest decodes to the exact latest payload and round-trips byte-identically.
Parser accepts exactly one driver; both ingress layers reject the first role/position VM Exec probe before persistence with exact GH #280 diagnostic and localization.
Exec/VM intent and describe preserve existing union arms; Exec Service probes remain accepted; VmNotAllowedOnServiceKind is removed.
Detached and streaming CLI lanes forward the selected union without new request shape and retain rendering/exits.

Workspace all-target compilation succeeds at the direct-V3 alias commit; V1/V2 types, envelope arms, exports, conversions, fixtures, decode, re-archive, migration, fallback, compatibility-prefix, field, and accessor surface are absent.

BackendDiscoveryBridge module, registration, dispatch variants, runtime View variants/helpers, producer wakes, and bridge-only helpers are directly retired in the same change.
Approved BE-01 through BE-12 and BE-P1 controls pass in-process; acceptance-designer-owned transfer or retirement preserves required bridge regressions and the seed-257209 witness.
Workspace all-target integration compilation passes with no dual-writer transition or unrelated persistence, consumer-acknowledgement, restart-policy, or lifecycle architecture change.
